selection.summary: Fixed issue #1241 by ensuring the first input position is valid for a match even during first usage of the context, by starting the reference at 1 instead of the problematic 0. In ZSTD_window_clear (lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h), the window end reference is now computed as endT + 1, so lowLimit and dictLimit start at 1, making position 0 invalid as a match reference.
